fields.name: Vault Dweller
fields.description:
Fresh to the wasteland, still learning your way around this world. Despite the name, this variant does not require you to be a Vault Dweller.

Resourceful. You begin the game with one extra Karma Cap.

Unexposed. You have disadvantage on all Radiation and Addiction checks.

entity.name: Psyker
entity.description:
A human who has unlocked the potential of their brain via mutation. Psykers have a wide range of abilities depending on the mutation they gain.

Psychic Ability. You unlock a psychic ability. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (to a minimum of 1) before needing a Long Rest. Every time you use a psychic ability, you must make an Endurance ability check with a DC equal to 12 + your levels of Exhaustion. On a success, you gain no side effects. On a failure, you gain a level of Exhaustion.

Choose one ability from this list:

The Sight. You have the ability to glimpse the future. When you use the ability, you roll a d20 and record the result. At any time, you can use this roll in place of another, whether it be yourself or another creature. Alternatively, you may flip one of your Karma Caps back over.

Telepathy. You have the ability to speak directly into others’ minds. This ability works on any creature within 300 ft. of you that is capable of speaking a language, and is translated into whatever language the creature speaks. You can only use this ability on creatures that you are aware of. Once you make a connection with a creature, it can also communicate with you telepathically until you make another connection with a different creature, at which point the telepathic line is severed.

If a creature is unwilling to link minds with you, they may try to resist it and make an Intelligence check with a DC equal to 10 + your Intelligence ability modifier. If they succeed, they do not link minds with you and you take 1d4 psychic damage to your HP. If they fail, their mind is linked to yours and they take 1d4 psychic damage to their HP.

Beastmaster. You have the ability to pacify and tame creatures with your mind. You gain the Wasteland Whisperer perk at rank 2, however instead of using your Charisma ability, you use your Intelligence ability. If you fail the check to pacify or tame an animal this way, you take 1d8 psychic damage to your HP.

Brain Blast. You have the ability to fire a blast of energy from your mind at enemies. This blast costs 6 AP and deals 2d10 psychic damage to the HP of all creatures within 10 ft. of you, including any allies. If a creature in the area of effect has an Intelligence score of 2 or lower, they are unaffected.

Pyrokinesis. You have the ability to create and control fire. With 3 AP, you can create a fireball that has the same stats as a Molotov Cocktail explosive. You still need to make an attack roll with this fireball after creating it. Additionally, you can spend 6 AP to put out flames in a 5 ft. space with your mind.

Electrokinesis. You have the ability to see and control electricity. With 2 AP, you can either give power to or cut off power to a device that uses electricity that you are within 5 ft. of. Additionally, you can passively sense electrical currents within 30 ft. of you, and with a DC 12 Perception ability check, you can determine what devices are being powered within 30 ft. of you.

Chronic Pain. The powers of a psyker are painful to those who possess it, frequently complaining about chronic headaches and migraines. The negative of levels of Exhaustion are doubled, so you have a -2 to all d20 rolls per level of Exhaustion.

Psychic Nullifier. While you’re wearing the Psychic Nullifier, you are immune to psychic damage and other Psykers cannot use their psychic abilities on you. Additionally, you do not suffer the extra negative effects of levels of Exhaustion. However, you cannot use your own psychic abilities while wearing the Nullifier. You start with x1 Psychic Nullifier in your inventory.

effects.text: Psychic Ability: uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest; each use needs an END check (DC 12 + Exhaustion) or you gain a level of Exhaustion.
Chronic Pain: each level of Exhaustion gives −2 to d20 rolls instead of −1 (not while wearing the Psychic Nullifier).

entity.name: Swampfolk
entity.description:
Descending from the destitute locals inhabiting the swamps, the Swampfolk are humans that suffer from mutations due to radiation and shallow gene pools. Swampfolk often suffer from significant deformities that drastically change their appearance. You are one of the fortunate ones whose deformities are minimal, able to pass as a normal human.

Swamp Living. Swampfolk are able to survive off of the most putrid of food and water sources. You take no Rads from food and drinks. Food with the Putrid or Pungent properties restore 2 levels of Hunger instead of 1, and you do not suffer the negative effects of food with these properties. Additionally, you are resistant to Poison damage and have advantage on Disease checks.

Inbred. Unfortunately, the Swampfolk weren’t the best at following safe population guidelines. As a result, you have multiple deformities. Your Charisma and Intelligence ability scores are decreased by 1. Additionally, whenever you make a Mutation Check, your DC is increased by 3.

Mutated. Swampfolk come with a wide variety of strange mutations due to their toxic environment and tangled family tree. When creating your character, either pick a Mutation or roll on the Mutation Table for a Mutation to be permanently applied to your character *(reroll 1s or 20s)*. This mutation cannot be cured or removed through radiation treatment.

effects.text: Poison damage
Swamp Living: no Rads from food and drinks; Putrid and Pungent food restore 2 levels of Hunger, without their negative effects; advantage on Disease checks.
Inbred: your Mutation Check DC is increased by 3. Mutated: one permanent Mutation.

entity.name: Dark Urge
entity.description:
You’ve developed a strange mutation that has caused your mind to be flooded by dark urges, pulling you towards cannibalism and other taboo practices. You’re still recognizably human, but your mutation has caused certain physical changes like sharper teeth and claw-like nails. This mutation can also present itself in other strange ways, like antlers, longer limbs, hair loss, etc., but it’s up to you what your mutations look like.

Cannibal. You start the game with the Cannibal perk. Additionally, you permanently have the Carnivore mutation.

Clawed. Dark Urge Humans often sport sharp, elongated nails that act as claws. When making an Unarmed Attack with no weapon, you deal an additional 1d8 damage.

Uncanny Speed. You move with uncanny speed when on the battlefield. When you spend AP to move, you can move a further 5 ft., to a total of 10 ft..

Dark Urge. The smell of blood causes the darkness within you to spring to the forefront. During combat, you must make at least one attack on every turn as long as you are able to. If there are no hostile creatures nearby, you must make a DC 12 Endurance ability check to resist the urge to attack. If you fail, you must attack the nearest neutral or friendly creature. If you are under the effects of a chem with the Psychosis property, you automatically fail this check.

effects.text: Clawed: Unarmed Attacks with no weapon deal an additional 1d8 damage.
Uncanny Speed: each AP spent on movement moves you 10 ft. instead of 5 ft.
Dark Urge: in combat you must attack every turn you are able to.

fields.name: Gen-3 Synth
fields.description:
Your character is secretly a Generation 3 Synth created by the Institute, a perfect recreation of a human being. Maybe you were sent by the Institute on a secret mission, maybe you were a synth rescued by the Railroad and are hiding from the Institute. Discuss with your Overseer about what your backstory could be and how it might affect your character.

Alternatively, when making your character, roll a d20. On a 20, your character is secretly a Gen-3 Synth.

Snack Fan. For some reason, all Gen-3 Synths really like a specific snack. Fancy Lad Snack Cakes now have the Flavorsome property instead of the Tasty property.

fields.name: Ancient Ghoul
fields.description:
You’ve been around a long time, trekking this wasteland. You have plenty of experience, but can also feel your mind slipping as the days go by. You can’t truly go on forever, after all.

Many Roads Walked. At 1st level, two skills of your choice are increased by 2 and you gain an extra Ghoul perk.

Old Bones. You are immune to poison damage and gain the Stitched Together perk.

Half Life. Your long life has taken its toll on you, and the risks of becoming feral have only increased. Whenever you make a Feral Check for leveling up, the DC is equal to your full level rather than half, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, your maximum Feral Level is lowered to 8 from 10.

effects.text: Poison damage
Many Roads Walked: two skills of your choice +2 and an extra Ghoul perk at 1st level. Half Life: your Feral Check for leveling up has a DC equal to your full level (max 20).

entity.name: Glowing One
entity.description:
Where normal ghouls would go feral when exposed to extreme radiation, you instead became one with the radiation and began Glowing. You’ve maintained your sanity where others have lost theirs, however you are highly radioactive.

The Glow. Glowing Ones interact with radiation in a unique way compared to other ghouls. You are no longer immune to Radiation and Rads and you can gain Radiation Levels, however you do not suffer the negative effects of them. When you make a Radiation Check from being in an Irradiated Zone, you can choose to automatically fail it and gain a level of Radiation. If you reach 10 levels of Radiation, you do not die, but cannot gain any more levels. These Radiation Levels can allow you to perform certain actions.

Glowing Mind. Radiation isn’t healthy for an aging mind. Whenever you make a Feral Check, the result is decreased by a number equal to your current levels of Radiation. Additionally, whenever you gain a level of Radiation, you must make a Feral Check with a DC of 5 + your Feral Levels.

Luminescent. They’re called “Glowing” for a reason! Whenever you have at least 1 level of Radiation, you emit Bright Light in a radius equal to 5 ft. x half your levels of Radiation, rounded down (to a minimum of 5 ft.). However, any Sneak skill rolls you make and your party’s Group Sneak are reduced by a number equal to your levels of Radiation.

Glowing One. Your unique mutation gives you special abilities using your inner radiation. On your turn, as long as you have at least 1 level of Radiation, you can spend 6 AP to remove a level of Radiation and perform one of the following abilities:

Heal a Ghoul within 5 ft. of you a number of HP equal to their Healing Rate.

Stabilize a Ghoul with the Dying condition within 5 ft. of you.

Give an attack an additional 1d8 radiation damage. This must be done before the attack roll is made.

Give yourself or a Ghoul within 5 ft. of you 1d8 Temporary HP.

effects.text: The Glow: you can gain Radiation levels but suffer none of their negative effects; at 10 you do not die.
Glowing Mind: your Feral Checks are lowered by your levels of Radiation.
Luminescent: your Sneak rolls and your party’s Group Sneak are lowered by your levels of Radiation.

fields.description:
The FEV strain used to create you wasn’t perfect, and there were some flaws in the mutation process. Your body was enhanced, while your mind was weakened.

Abnormal Growth. Your body has mutated to an abnormal degree, causing immense muscle growth. You gain +2 to your Strength and Endurance ability scores (in addition to *Superior Strength)*. Additionally, your Strength ability score now has a maximum of 12 instead of 10, and cannot be lower than 8.

*(If your Strength score is lower than 8 after applying the bonus, you must lower one or more ability scores to get your Strength to at least 8.)*

Mental Degradation. Your Intelligence ability score is reduced by 2 and cannot be higher than 3.

*(If your Intelligence score is greater than 3 after applying the negative modifier, you must take the extra points and put them in another ability score.)*

Adverse Mutation. The FEV process was imperfect and caused some adverse mutations. When creating your character, either pick a Mutation or roll on the Mutation Table for a Mutation to be permanently applied to your character *(reroll 1s or 20s)*. This mutation cannot be cured or removed through radiation treatment.

effects.text: Abnormal Growth: Strength has a maximum of 12. Mental Degradation: Intelligence cannot be higher than 3. Adverse Mutation: one permanent Mutation.

fields.description:
Stealth Boys interact with Super Mutant physiology in a unique way, slowly changing their skin tone to a bluish gray and warping their mind the longer a Super Mutant uses them. Super Mutants with this condition are known as “Nightkin”.

Stealth Boys. You start the game with 3 Stealth Boys in your inventory.

Skilled Assassin. When you successfully make a Sneak Attack, you deal an additional 1d6 damage.

Addiction. You have an Addiction to the cloaking field Stealth Boys create, which cannot be cured. If you are not under the effects of a Stealth Boy, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma ability and skill checks.

Psychosis. Stealth Boys have an adverse effect on the mind of Super Mutants. Every time you use a Stealth Boy, make a DC 14 Endurance ability check. On a failure, you have disadvantage on any Perception ability or skill check and your Passive Sense is decreased by 2 (to a minimum of 1) for 24 hours.

effects.text: Skilled Assassin: Sneak Attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage.
Addiction: without a Stealth Boy active you have disadvantage on Charisma ability and skill checks.
Psychosis: each Stealth Boy use needs a DC 14 END check, or for 24 hours you have disadvantage on Perception and −2 Passive Sense.

fields.name: Prototype
fields.description:
You’re a prototype model of synth, a mid-way point between Gen-2s and Gen-3s, commonly known as “Gen-2.5”. This comes with greatly improved artificial intelligence, though the hardware has trouble keeping up.

Artificial Intelligence Algorithms. You’re designed with a more advanced artificial intelligence. When you gain skill points by leveling up, you gain an additional +1 skill point. Additionally, your Intelligence ability score is increased by 2 (to a maximum of 10).

Limiting Hardware. Your memory capacity is small, and as a result you suffer input lag the more memories you collect. For every 5 levels you have, your Combat Sequence rolls and max AP are reduced by 1 (min 6 AP). Additionally, your RAM Limit for Robot Overclock Programs is halved (to a minimum of 1).

effects.text: Limiting Hardware: −1 Combat Sequence and max AP for every 5 levels (min 6 AP); your RAM Limit for Robot Overclock Programs is halved.

fields.description:
The Handy robot is a maintenance and construction robot with multiple, multi-jointed appendages, which levitates thanks to its powerful jet-powered engine. They were generally in use as butlers, maintenance workers and sometimes also employed as guards before the Great War.

While oftentimes their name suggests a gender role, “Mister Handy” or “Miss Handy” is simply a name to describe the robot's model. Handy’s have multitudes of voices, personalities, and names and can present themselves as any gender.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. Handy’s have a less human shape to them than other robots, floating off the ground with three appendages and three eyes attached to a large round core. You have three arms, three eyes, and can have up to three hands if you choose to have three Grippers in the *Incredible Multi-Talented Appliance* section below. You do not have a head, groin, or legs that can be targeted by targeted attacks or severed. Instead; targeted attacks to your eyes cost 2 less AP and creatures can target your jet engine. The jet engine functions exactly the same as a targeted attack to the legs, except the attack costs 2 more AP. If your jet engine is severed, you fall prone and cannot move until it is reattached.

Fuel. You require fuel to continue to operate. Every week, you must refill your tank with x1 Fuel Canister, x6 oil materials, or x1 Mr. Handy Fuel junk item, which are consumed upon use. This fuel will last you for another week. Alternatively, you can load a Fusion Core into your chassis. This will last you for a full month.

If you do not refuel after a week, at the start of every subsequent day you must make a DC 12 Endurance ability check. If you fail, you lose power and fall Unconscious until another creature fills your tank with fuel. The DC increases by 2 after every success.

Jet Engine. You hover a few feet off the ground while active and moving. You don't trigger any floor based traps or activated effects. However, if you are knocked prone, become stunned, or fall unconscious, you fall to the ground.

Incredible Multi-Talented Appliance! Handy’s have 3 arms that can be equipped with numerous different tools, which count as Integrated Weapons. However, unlike other robots, if one of the Handy’s arms does not have the Gripper attachment, that arm is considered to not have a hand. Your Integrated Weapons do need to be reloaded.

Choose 3 tools or weapons from the following list that are attached to your arms. You can have multiple of the same tool/weapon if desired.

Buzz Saw. A mechanical saw used to cut wood, food, bodies, or debris.

Melee Weapon. 5 AP. 1d10 slashing. Critical Hit: 20/x3 + Bleeding. Special Properties: Cleave, Durable.

Clippers. A large, sharp set of clippers for wiring, gardening, or opening boxes.

Melee Weapon. 3 AP. 1d4 piercing. Critical Hit: 19/1d4 piercing. Special Properties: Dismember, Durable.

Drill. This drill has interchanging bits used for screws, nuts, bolts, and pilot holes.

Melee Weapon. 4 AP. 1d8 slashing. Critical Hit: 19/level of Bleeding. Special Properties: Durable, Mangle, Precise.

Gripper. The Gripper is two finger-like appendages that can grab, twist, operate, use weapons, and hold items, operating at similar efficiency to a human hand. If you do not have at least two of these tools, you effectively only have one hand. If you do not have any of these tools, you effectively have no hands.

Torch. This kitchen tool emits a flame with an adjustable nozzle for cooking, flambéing, taking care of pesky bug nests, or lighting candles.

Ranged Weapon, 10 ft. line. 5 AP. 1d10 fire. Ammo: Fuel Canister, 5 rounds *(1 canister)*. Special Properties: Area of Effect, Durable, Incendiary.

If your Integrated Weapon requires ammo, you begin the game with some ammo for that weapon.

*(Torch = x5 fuel canisters)*

One of the most widespread robot models, Protectrons were designed as an inexpensive work drone capable of performing a wide variety of tasks from construction, security, office work, and more. Though they’re very versatile, they’re also fairly simple and slow machines.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. Protectrons, while still a robotic oddity, have a human-like shape and appendages. You have two arms, two legs, two hands, two feet, a head, and a torso, but you do not have eyes or a groin.

Reinforced Plating. Your DT increases by 1 in addition to any armor you wear.

Protective Glass. If you take a Severe Injury to the Head, you can instead choose to have your protective glass shield break and ignore the injury. This can only be done once before the glass shield must be repaired. Repairing the glass shield costs x5 glass and x1 steel and takes 1 hour.

Slow. Protectrons can only spend a maximum of 6 AP on movement during their turns, and the Sprint action only moves you 30 ft. instead of 50 ft..

Protect and Serve. Protectrons can come with a variety of tools and weapons built into their arm, which count as Integrated Weapons. For Protectrons, an arm with an Integrated Weapon is considered to still have a usable hand. However, your Integrated Weapons do need to be reloaded.

Choose one tool or weapon from the following list that is attached to your arm.

Taser. Often seen on Police Protectrons, used to stun criminals - if they could catch them, at least. Melee Weapon, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 AP. 2d8 electricity damage. Critical Hit: 20, x2 applies dazed. Special Properties: Durable.

Laser. The basic integrated weapon most Protectron units are installed with.

Ranged Weapon, range: x10/x20, one target. 4 AP. Damage: 1d8 laser. Critical Hit: 20, x2 + Burning. Ammo: Energy Cell, 30 rounds *(1 cell)*. Special Properties: Energy Weapon, Durable, Semi-Automatic, Quick Reload.

Defibrillator. An integrated device for Medic Protectrons for reviving injured individuals.

Unarmed Weapon, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 AP. 2d8 electricity damage. Critical Hit: 20/1d8. Special Properties: Durable, Revitalizing.

Cryo Spray. A cryogenic nozzle used by Fire Brigadier Protectrons to put out fires.

Ranged Weapon, 20 ft. cone. 5 AP. Damage: 2d4 cold. Ammo: Cryo Cell, 3 rounds *(1 cell)*. Special Properties: Area of Effect, Durable, Freezing, Slow.

Nail Gun. An industrial tool used by Utility Protectrons for construction work.

Ranged Weapon, range: x3/x15, up to 4 targets within 10 ft. of each other. 6 AP. Damage: 1d4 piercing damage. Critical Hit: 20/x3. Ammo: Nails, 90 rounds. Special Properties: Automatic (3), Durable, Silent, Armor Piercing.

If your Integrated Weapon requires ammo, you begin the game with some ammo for that weapon.

*(Laser = x5 energy cells, Cryo Spray = x5 cryo cells, Nail Gun = x180 nails.)*

The Robobrain was designed from the ground up as a multirole platform for use by military and civilian clients. They are more flexible and powerful than robots due to the fact that their central control and processing unit is an actual brain, rather than an artificial facsimile. Coupled with a robust, all-terrain tracked chassis and powerful armaments, the Robobrain was on the forefront of a new revolution in combat robotics.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. Robobrains have a humanoid shape and appendages. You have two arms, two hands, a head, and a torso, but you do not have legs, feet, eyes, or a groin. Instead of legs, you have All Terrain Rollers. The Rollers function exactly the same as a targeted attack to the legs except they cannot be severed.

All Terrain Rollers. You do not have to spend extra AP to move through Difficult Terrain.

NeuroTransmitters. When you take damage from a targeted attack to the head, you gain two conditions instead of one. Additionally, you are no longer immune to psychic attacks.

Integrated Weapons. Robobrains do not come with any weapons integrated into their arms by default, however it is possible for them to gain Integrated Weapons if modified.

Mesmetron. Robobrains come equipped with an experimental Mesmetron weapon, channeling their mental energy into a blast of psychic damage. This counts as an Integrated Weapon, but is not attached to one of your arms.

The Mesmetron does not need to be reloaded, and instead can be used a number of times equal to your Intelligence ability modifier (to a minimum of 1) before needing to take a Long Rest. If you gain the Dazed or Concussed conditions, you cannot use your Mesmetron until the condition is removed.

Ranged Weapon, range 30 ft., one target. 5 AP. Damage: 1d6 psychic damage. Critical Hit 20/Dazed for 3 turns. Special Properties: Energy Weapon, Durable, Powerful.

effects.text: NeuroTransmitters: a targeted attack to the head gives two conditions instead of one, and you are not immune to psychic attacks.
All Terrain Rollers: no extra AP to move through Difficult Terrain.

entity.name: Assaultron
entity.description:
The Assaultron was designed for the US Army as a frontline wartime robot combatant. It is fast and deadly at close range and employs a devastating laser at a distance. Some units can even employ stealth technology. They are quick, nimble and customizable, with a variety of weaponry such as lasers and razor-sharp claws.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. Assaultrons have a humanoid shape and appendages. You have two legs, two feet, two arms, two hands, a torso, a head, and an eye, but you do not have a groin.

Unarmed Combatant. Assaultrons have two sharpened claw hands that give an extra 1d4 damage to Unarmed Strikes. If you wield an Unarmed Weapon or Melee Weapon, or replace one of your hands with a different weapon, this bonus does not apply.

Integrated Weapons. Assaultrons do not come with any weapons integrated into their arms by default, however it is possible for them to gain Integrated Weapons if modified.

Perceptive Machine. Assaultrons are designed to constantly monitor their surroundings. Your Passive Sense is increased by 2.

Eye Laser. An Assaultron has a built-in Eye Laser that it can use during combat, capable of dealing devastating damage. The Eye Laser needs to be charged before it can be used. It costs 6 AP to charge the laser, which lasts an entire turn. If you do not use this charge on the next turn, the charge runs out. It costs 6 AP to fire the laser once charged on a previous turn, and it cannot be fired again until recharged. Once fired, all creatures within a 30 ft. long, 5 ft. wide line centered on the Assaultron take damage, the amount of which is determined by your level. This damage is modified by your Perception ability modifier, like Energy Weapons, however it is not affected by perks that affect Energy Weapons.

See the table below for the damage:

Levels — Eye Laser Damage

1-5 — 1d6 laser damage

6-10 — 2d6 laser damage

11-15 — 2d8 laser damage

16-20 — 2d10 laser damage

21-25 — 3d10 laser damage

26+ — 5d10 laser damage

You can charge your Eye Laser a number of times equal to your Endurance ability modifier (to a minimum of 1) before needing to take a Long Rest.

However, such power comes with a cost, and the devastating laser can quickly damage the fragile electronics housed in the head. Each use of your Eye Laser will add 1 Level of Decay to it. See the table below for the effects of each level of Decay.

Level of Decay — Effects

1 — No effect.

3 — Damage decreases a level (min 1d6). Passive Sense is decreased by 2.

5 — Damage decreases a level (min 1d6). Passive Sense is decreased by 4. Bright Light is now considered Dim Light.

7 — Damage decreases a level (min 1d6). Passive Sense is decreased by 4. Bright Light is now considered Dim Light. -2 to all attack rolls.

9 — Damage decreases a level (min 1d6). Passive Sense is decreased by 4. Dim Light is now considered Darkness. Disadvantage on all attack rolls.

10 — Eye Laser breaks. You gain the Blinded condition until it is repaired.

If you take damage to your HP from a Targeted Attack to your Eye, your Eye Laser will take 1 Level of Decay. If you suffer the *Eye Gouged* Severe Injury, your Eye instantly gains 10 levels of Decay, you gain the Blinded condition, and you are unable to use your Eye Laser until it is repaired.

You can repair 1 level of Decay on your Eye Laser with x5 steel and x8 circuitry materials and a DC 15 Crafting skill check. It takes a number of minutes equal to 20 - your Crafting skill modifier.

If your Eye breaks, it can be repaired to 5 Levels of Decay with x25 steel and x40 circuitry materials and a DC 20 Crafting skill check. It takes a number of minutes equal to 100 - your Crafting skill modifier.

entity.name: Securitron
entity.description:
The PDQ-88b Securitron is a large, monowheel robot with a titanium alloy housing, resistant to shrapnel and small arms fire, with a screen capable of displaying a wide array of images, from static images to pre-War commercials. Securitrons running on the MK1 operating system do not have full access to their full arsenal or their auto-repair systems. The MK2 Operating System was experimental and never finished, remaining locked within the Securitrons’ systems.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. Securitrons have a vaguely humanoid shape. You have a torso, two arms, and two hands, but you do not have eyes, a groin, feet, a head, or legs. Instead of legs, you have a Monowheel. Instead of a Head, you have a Face Screen. Targeted attacks against your torso cost 2 less AP.

Reinforced Plating. Securitrons are built with tough, titanium-plated armor. Your DT increases by 1.

Face Screen. You have a screen for a face that can display any image you would like. If this screen gets destroyed by a Severe Injury, you are functionally Permanently Blinded.

Monowheel. You do not have to spend additional AP to move through Difficult Terrain. However, standing up from prone now costs 6 AP instead of 5 AP.

Operating System. All Securitrons are installed with two versions of their operating system, MK1 and MK2. Every Securitron starts with the MK1 Operating System, while the MK2 Operating System is locked and inaccessible by their software.

MK1 Operating System

System Hack. You may upgrade to the MK2 Operating System with 20 circuitry and a DC 20 Science skill check. On a failure, you do not upgrade and lose the resources. On a success, you upgrade to the MK2 Operating System. See the Securiton MK2 variant. You can only attempt a system hack once before needing to take a long rest.

Peacekeeper. MK1 Securitrons have access to 2 different kinds of weapons connected to their arms, which count as Integrated Weapons. For Securitrons, an arm with an Integrated Weapon is considered to still have a usable hand. However, your Integrated Weapons do need to be reloaded.

Choose one weapon from the following list that is attached to your arm:

9mm SMG. Ranged Weapon, range: x6/x8, up to 3 targets within 10 ft. of each other. 6 AP. Damage: 1d4 ballistic damage. Crit chance: 20/1d4. Ammo: 9mm, 30 rounds. Special Properties: Automatic (2), Durable.

X25 Gatling Laser. Ranged Weapon, range x10/x15, up to 3 targets within 10 ft. of each other. 6 AP. Damage: 1d8 laser damage. Crit chance: 20/1d8 + Burning. Ammo: Microfusion Cell, 30 rounds (1 cell). Special Properties: Automatic (2), Energy Weapon, Durable.

If your Integrated Weapon requires ammo, you begin the game with some ammo for that weapon. *(SMG = 60 9mm rounds, Laser = 5 microfusion cells)*

MK2 Operating System

Experimental OS. The MK2 Operating System wasn’t finished and has many bugs and issues. You can no longer use Robot Overclock Programs, and whenever an integrated weapon would take a level of Decay, it takes 2 levels of Decay instead of 1.

However, you have unlocked two new integrated weapons - the G-28 Grenade Launcher and M-235 Grenade Launcher - and the Auto-Repair System.

Auto-Repair System. You can use 6 AP on your turn to heal HP equal to your Healing Rate. You can do this a number of times equal to half your END modifier before needing a long rest.

Unlocked Potential. With the MK2 Operating System, Securitrons gain access to a selection of new weaponry stored in their chassis. You gain an additional Integrated Weapon into your other arm, and can optionally replace your original MK1 Integrated Weapon with a new weapon. These new Integrated Weapons do still need to be reloaded.

Choose one weapon from the following list and optionally choose another to replace your original weapon:

9mm SMG. Ranged Weapon, range: x6/x8, up to 3 targets within 10 ft. of each other. 6 AP. Damage: 1d4 ballistic damage. Crit chance: 20/1d4. Ammo: 9mm, 30 rounds. Special Properties: Automatic (2), Durable.

X25 Gatling Laser. Ranged Weapon, range x10/x15, up to 3 targets within 10 ft. of each other. 6 AP. Damage: 1d8 laser damage. Crit chance: 20/1d8 + Burning. Ammo: Microfusion Cell, 30 rounds (1 cell). Special Properties: Automatic (2), Energy Weapon, Durable.

G-28 Grenade Launcher. Launched Explosive Weapon, range x2/x6. 5 AP. 2d6 explosive damage (10 ft. radius). Ammo: 25mm Grenades, 4 rounds. Special Properties: Area of Effect, Destructive, Slow, Durable.

M-235 Missile Launcher. Launched Explosive Weapon. 6 AP. Range x10/x40. 5d6 explosive damage (10 ft. radius). Ammo: Missile, 4 rounds. Special Properties: Area of Effect, Destructive, Slow, Durable.

entity.name: Automatron
entity.description:
A robot crafted out of the parts of many other robots. While hardly the pinnacle of robotic engineering, automatrons such as these are capable of combining the traits of many robots in one casing. However, this hodgepodge collection of parts could hardly be considered stable or well-made.

Poorly Made. Your robotic body isn’t very well constructed, and as a result, making any repairs to your body costs double the materials it normally would. Additionally, Targeted Attacks to any of your body parts deal an additional 1d6 damage on top of any extra damage from the limb itself, and you gain 2 conditions when hit by any Targeted Attack.

Collection of Parts. Automatrons consist of multiple different robots put together. You can choose what body parts to take from what robots, taking on that part’s positives and negatives. Not all parts work together well, and some may have additional negatives if used without their complementary components.

*Note: You cannot have 4 parts from the same robot variant.*

Automatron Head

Protectron Head. You have a Protectron’s head.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Head but no Eyes.

Off-balance. Without a Protectron or Robobrain torso, you have -1 to your AP.

Protective Glass. See *Protective Glass* feature for Protectrons.

Handy Head. You have a Handy’s head.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have no Head but 3 Eyes. Targeted attacks to your eyes cost 2 less AP.

More Eyes. You have +1 to your Passive Sense.

Fragile. Targeted attacks to your Eyes deal full damage.

Robobrain Head. You have a Robobrain’s head.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Head but no Eyes.

NeuroTransmitters. See *NeuroTransmitters* feature for Robobrains.

Mesmertron. See *Mesmertron* feature for Robobrains.

Assaultron Head. You have an Assaultron’s head.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Head and 1 Eye.

Eye Laser. See *Eye Laser* feature for Assaultrons.

Unstable. Your Eye Laser takes 2 levels of Decay with every use.

Automatron Torso

Protectron Torso. You have a Protectron’s torso.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Torso.

Sturdy. You have +1 DT.

Handy Torso. You have a Handy’s torso.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Torso.

Rounded. You have +1 AC.

Robobrain Torso. You have a Robobrain’s torso.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Torso. Targeted attacks to your torso costs 2 less AP.

Sturdy. You have +1 DT.

Assaultron Torso. You have an Assaultron’s torso.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Torso.

Accentuated Servos. You have +10 Carry Weight.

Securitron Torso. You have a Securitron's torso.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have a Torso. Targeted attacks against your torso cost 2 less AP.

Face Screen. See *Face Screen* feature for Securitrons.

Reinforced Plating. You have +1 DT.

Automatron Legs

Protectron Legs. You have a Protectron’s legs.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Legs.

Slow. See *Slow* feature for Protectrons.

Sturdy. You have +1 DT.

Handy Thruster. You have a Handy’s thruster.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have no legs, but you have a Thruster.

Jet Engine. See *Jet Engine* feature for Handys.

Fuel. See *Fuel* feature for Handys.

Off-balance. Without the Handy Torso, you have disadvantage on checks to avoid being knocked down *(ie. being shoved)*.

Robobrain Treads. You have a Robobrain’s treads.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have no legs, but you have Treads.

All-Terrain Rollers. See *All-Terrain Rollers* feature for Robobrains.

Assaultron Legs. You have an Assaultron’s legs.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Legs.

Fast. If you spend at least 5 AP to move on a turn, you can move an additional 5 ft. for no cost.

Fragile. Targeted attacks against your Legs will deal +2 damage.

Securitron Monowheel. You have a Securitron’s monowheel.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have no legs, but you have a Monowheel.

Monowheel. See *Monowheel* feature for Securitrons.

Automatron Arms

Protectron Arms. You have a Protectron’s arms.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Arms.

Protect and Serve. See *Protect and Serve* feature for Protectrons.

Clumsy. Whenever your non-Integrated weapons would gain a level of Decay, they gain 2 levels instead.

Handy Arms. You have a Handy’s arms.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have up to three Arms.

Incredible Multi-Talented Appliance! See *Incredible Multi-Talented Appliance!* feature for Handys.

Handy. Without a Handy torso, you can only have 2 Handy arms.

Fragile. Targeted Attacks to your Arms deal full damage.

Robobrain Arms. You have a Robobrain’s arms.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Arms.

Assaultron Arms. You have an Assaultron’s arms.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Arms.

Unarmed Combatant. See *Unarmed Combatant* feature for Assaultrons.

Securitron Arms. You have a Securitron’s arms.

Limbs and Targeted Attacks. You have two Arms.

Peacekeeper. See *Peacekeeper* feature for Securitrons.

fields.description:
If you’d like to instead craft your own background within the post-apocalypse, choose this option for your background instead of the ones listed below.

Skills: +2 to three different skills.

Trait: Choose a Trait.

Starting Equipment: You can choose any background’s starting equipment, or you can choose your own items at the Overseer’s discretion with a budget of 850 caps.

Whether you were born into this life or these people brought hope to you when you hit rock bottom. You are in service to a group of followers who zealously recruit all they can find into their doctrine. This new world, born of fire, is a gift. Only now that this world has been cleansed can the truth be seen. You now wander the wastes looking for signs and awaiting orders from the great beyond.

Skills: +2 to Melee Weapons, Speech, and Sneak.

Trait: The Sight Beyond

Starting Equipment: Human Cultist

x1 lead-lined *(rank 1)* cloth armor, x1 knife, x1 bolt-action pipe pistol, x25 .308 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 chain, x3 cram, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x1 healing powder, x3 dirty water, x1 purified water, and x50 caps. *(Total Load: 44)

Ghoul or Super Mutant Cultist

x1 leather armor, x1 knife, x1 bolt-action pipe pistol, x25 .308 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 chain, x3 cram, x4 dirty water, x1 stimpak, x1 diluted stimpak, and x50 caps. *(Total Load: )

Gen-2 Synth Cultist

x1 leather armor, x1 knife, x1 bolt-action pipe pistol, x25 .308 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 chain, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 overclock hardware, x1 cache clearer, and x50 caps.

Robot Cultist

x1 leather armor, x1 knife, x1 bolt-action pipe pistol, x15 .308 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 chain, x2 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 overclock hardware, x1 cache clearer, and x50 caps.

At a young age you’ve always wanted to help others. You’ve learned how to have a steady hand and to be calm under pressure from old world books and other experienced doctors. Work is hard, you see little breaks, and people are desperate. You wander the wasteland in search of others to help, or the caps they provide.

Skills: +2 to Breach, Medicine, and Science.

Trait: Do No Harm

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Doctor

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (4 levels of Decay), x1 syringer, x3 stimpak loader syringes, x2 lock joint syringe, x1 bag (backpack), x1 first aid kit, x2 diluted stimpaks, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x1 healing powder, a sleeping bag, one person tent, x1 noodle cup, x1 instamash, x2 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Doctor

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (4 levels of Decay), x1 syringer, x3 stimpak loader syringes, x2 lock joint syringe, x1 bag (backpack), x1 first aid kit, x2 robot repair kit 1.0, x2 robot repair kit 2.0, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x2 healing powder, and x50 caps.

Born into this rotten world and treated like less than dirt, you’ve wandered from city to city, shelter to shelter, trying to stay alive. The only friends you’ve had are thieves, beggars, or worse. You’ve never known riches and you only survive off the backs of others. Everything you own has its own story on how you claimed it. Things are going to change now, you take a hold of your life for the first time to make things right.

Skills: +2 to Breach, Sneak, and Unarmed.

Trait: Street Rat

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Drifter

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x5 canned dog food, x1 iguana on a stick, x2 healing powder, x4 dirty water, x2 purified water, x1 lockpicks, x1 one person tent, x1 sleeping bag, x1 whiskey, x1 fixer, x2 jet, x3 cigarettes, x1 psycho, x1 coffee and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Drifter

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 lockpicks, x2 robot repair kit 1.0, x2 overclock hardware, x2 cache clearer, x1 military auto-tank AI upload, x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 ¡La Fantoma! skill magazine and x50 caps.

Talented since you were young, you marvel wastelanders with your exceptional ability to perform. This life doesn’t come easy though. You’ve been extorted, swindled, targeted, and been made a fool more than once. When you’re a star, everyone wants to glimmer just as bright. You’re wandering the wasteland looking for the next gig, or maybe you want to keep your talents on hold for now.

Skills: +2 to Barter, Speech, and Intimidation.

Trait: A Moment of Respite

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Entertainer

x1 cloth armor, x1 switchblade, x1 10mm pistol (3 levels of Decay), x25 10mm ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x2 dynamite, x3 flares, x3 salisbury steak, x1 desert salad, x1 nuka-cola, x1 dirty wastelander, x1 healing powder, x1 stimpak, x2 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Entertainer

x1 cloth armor, x1 switchblade, x1 10mm pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 10mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x2 dynamite, x3 flares, x2 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

Born on a wide swath of land, or inherited by family, or gifted by some rich benefactor. You only know your life to be working the land to bring one of the most valuable resources in the wasteland, food. You know how to cook, what kind of creatures taste the best, and how to fix up just about anything. Being this savvy in the wasteland often draws eyes, and you’ve seen your share of those who will do anything to take what you have built. Either something has befallen your crop, your animals have gone sick, or one of those desperate folks finally torched your home. Either way, you’re wandering the wasteland to rebuild or repair your farm.

Skills: +2 to Crafting, Intimidation, and Survival.

Trait: Hardened by the Earth

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Farmer

x1 cloth armor, x1 pitchfork (5 levels of Decay), x1 single shotgun (3 levels of Decay), x15 20 gauge ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 healing powder, x5 potatoes, x5 tomatoes, x5 mutfruit, x4 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Farmer

x1 cloth armor, x1 pitchfork (5 levels of Decay), x1 sickle, x1 single shotgun (3 levels of Decay), x15 20 gauge ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 robot repair kit, x2 potatoes, x2 tomatoes, x1 mutfruit, and x50 caps.

“It’s an easy job”, you remember hearing from some of your friends. Then you remember the countless ghouls you’ve had to incinerate, or the sting in your eyes as you kept watch at dawn, or the family’s you’ve had to turn away from safety. You were trained to keep those who were paying you safe. Working alongside a team who had your back in the toughest of situations. But you’ve since left your job, putting your skills to use in the wasteland.

Skills: +2 to Guns, Speech, and Melee Weapons.

Trait: Vigilant Watch

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Guard

x1 metal armor (1 level of Decay), x1 police baton (2 levels of Decay), x1 9mm pistol, x35 9mm ammo, x10 9mm rubber ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 binoculars, x1 diluted stimpak, x3 purified water, x2 pork n’ beans, x1 coffee, x2 donuts, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Guard

x1 metal armor (1 level of Decay), x1 police baton (2 levels of Decay), x1 9mm pistol, x35 9mm ammo, x20 9mm rubber ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 binoculars, x2 robot repair kit, x1 Milsurp Review magazine, x1 cache clearer, and x50 caps.

Whether by choice or exile, you have lived most of your life in the middle of the wasteland far from any civilization. You’ve learned how to keep the only one who matters alive, you. Building traps, memorizing the land, and surviving at the edge of the world. You’ve seen creatures and phenomena that no one would believe. You’ve finally set off from your reclusivity to ensure what you’ve learned doesn’t die with you.

Skills: +2 to Explosives, Medicine, and Survival.

Trait: Recluse

Starting Equipment: Human Hermit

x1 multilayered armor (2 levels of Decay), x1 sharpened pole, x2 dynamite, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 bear trap, x1 mutt chops, x1 gecko steak, x1 diluted RadAway, x3 healing powder, x1 first aid kit, x1 purified water, x2 dirty water, and x50 caps.

Ghoul or Super Mutant Hermit

x1 multilayered armor (2 levels of Decay), x1 sharpened pole, x2 dynamite, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 bear trap, x1 mutt chops, x1 gecko steak, x1 iguana on a stick, x4 healing powder, x1 first aid kit, x4 dirty water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Hermit

x1 multilayered armor, x1 strengthened sharpened pole, x3 dynamite, x1 bag (backpack), x1 bear trap, x2 robot repair kit 2.0 and x50 caps.

While many see the career of a reporter to be something of a relic from the old world, you couldn’t disagree more. The truth is important in the wasteland, this world still has its fair share of people who are competing to survive. And in major cities, there are many of these people who would profit off the backs of others or let history fade into obscurity. It’s your job and purpose to see that the people of the wasteland are properly informed, even if you have to break a few laws to get to that truth. But lately you haven’t been seeing much action. You’re venturing into the wastes to find the perfect story.

Skills: +2 to Breach, Speech, and Sneak.

Trait: Persistent

Starting Equipment: Human Journalist

x1 cloth armor, x1 switchblade, x1 9mm pistol (3 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 bandolier, x1 lockpick, x3 cram, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x1 diluted stimpak, x3 purified water, x1 ProSnap Deluxe camera, x12 camera film, and x50 caps.

Ghoul or Super Mutant Journalist

x1 cloth armor, x1 switchblade, x1 9mm pistol (3 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 bandolier, x1 lockpick, x3 cram, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 calmex, x3 purified water, x1 ProSnap Deluxe camera, x12 camera film, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Journalist

x1 cloth armor, x1 switchblade, x1 9mm pistol (2 levels of Decay), x35 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 bandolier, x1 lockpick, x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 coolant rerouter, x1 ProSnap Deluxe camera, x12 camera film, and x50 caps.

Long days, good pay. In the early days your body ached each time you’d come home. But now you’ve grown accustomed to the hard labor you’ve done day in and day out. Whether you moved belongings, rebuilt houses, planted seeds, delivered water, etc. You’ve helped others and helped yourself with honest work. But jobs have run short, and you’ve now turned to wandering the wasteland in search of better fortune.

Skills: +2 to Crafting, Speech, and Melee Weapons.

Trait: Long Days, Long Nights

Starting Equipment: Human or Super Mutant Laborer

x1 cloth armor, x1 crowbar, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 canteen, x1 rope, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 potato crisps, x2 instamash, x1 radstag stew, x2 purified water, x2 healing powder, and x50 caps.

Ghoul Laborer

x1 cloth armor, x1 crowbar, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 canteen, x1 rope, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 potato crisps, x2 instamash, x1 radstag stew, x4 dirty water, x1 stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Laborer

x1 cloth armor, x1 crowbar, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 backpack, x1 rope, x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

In a broken world, you’re one of the few strands holding it together. Fixing things is your speciality, and since you were young you’ve always been fascinated with how things work. Especially the mysteries of technology from the old war. You’ve oiled countless guns, tightened triggers, scrapped old pieces for new ones, and used metric tons of duct tape. You figure your skills could be best used out in the wasteland.

Skills: +2 to Crafting, Guns, and Science.

Trait: Proper Maintenance

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Mechanic

x1 cloth armor, x1 wrench, x1 pipe revolver, x20 .44 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 bandolier, x1 canteen, x1 rope, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x3 cram, x3 purified water, x1 weapon repair kit, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Mechanic

x1 cloth armor, x1 wrench, x1 pipe revolver, x25 .44 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 bandolier, x1 rope, x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x2 weapon repair kit, and x50 caps.

To look tough you’ve got to act tough. Your name has gone down in reputation as a reliable protector. You’ve walked hundreds of miles guarding caravan and sniped down countless ghouls and radscorpions. It’s dangerous work, and many have tried to cheat you. But few live to tell the tale.

Skills: +2 to Guns, Melee Weapons, and Survival.

Trait: Sweeten the Deal

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Mercenary

x1 leather armor, x1 combat knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 trail carbine (2 levels of Decay), x20 .44 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x2 cram, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Mercenary

x1 leather armor, x1 combat knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 trail carbine (2 levels of Decay), x25 .44 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

Born into the church, you’ve brought hope and sanctity to many who were lost in the darkness. Your words of encouragement have brought many into your circle and you’ve crafted a small community of believers who hope to shape the world and themselves into a better place, whatever they believe in. Even still, you’ve seen your fair share of skeptics, some even hostile. You’ve learned to accept their criticisms and always front your belief, but never to let it waver you. You’re wandering the wasteland now in search of other believers, or proof of your higher powers' existence.

Skills: +2 to Barter, Intimidation, and Speech.

Trait: Embolden

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Pastor

x1 cloth armor, x1 single shotgun (3 levels of Decay), x20 20 gauge ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x3 pork ‘n beans, x1 donut, x1 coffee, x3 purified water, x1 first aid kit, x3 healing powder, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Pastor

x1 cloth armor, x1 single shotgun (2 levels of Decay), x20 20 gauge ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 first aid kit, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

Your home was compromised, whether by a powerful faction, ghouls, or raiders. You, and your family, have made a long journey across the wasteland to find a new home. Using everything you can to survive, even the old world weapons you’ve kept in your family’s lineage. But your people have now scattered, and it’s up to you to find them or a new home to settle.

Skills: +2 to Energy Weapons, Sneak, and Survival.

Trait: Long Roads

Starting Equipment: Human Pilgrim

x1 light *(rank 1)* leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 laser rifle (5 levels of Decay), x10 microfusion cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x2 mutfruit, x2 apples, x1 vegetable soup, x2 purified water, x1 healing powder, and x50 caps.

Ghoul or Super Mutant Pilgrim

x1 light *(rank 1)* leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 laser rifle (5 levels of Decay), x10 microfusion cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x2 mutfruit, x2 apples, x1 vegetable soup, x3 dirty water, x1 nuka-cola, x1 diluted stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Pilgrim

x1 light *(rank 1)* leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 laser rifle (5 levels of Decay), x10 microfusion cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 bandolier, x1 binoculars, x1 grappling hook, x1 rope, robot repair kit 1.0, and x50 caps.

It takes a lot to get back up and keep going, but it’s all you’ve known. Wastelanders place their hard earned caps on your ability to fight, that burden fuels your every punch. You’ve taken down many competitors, and have felt the bitter taste of defeat but it only ever makes your victory that much sweeter. However, something has happened to your establishment. And now you must wander the wastes with your skills to find a new purpose in life.

Skills: +2 to Barter, Melee Weapons, and Unarmed.

Trait: Endure the Battle

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Pit Fighter

x1 lead pipe (2 levels of Decay), x1 brass knuckles, x1 spiked knuckles, x1 bandolier, x1 ball bearings, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x3 cram, x1 vodka, x3 healing powder, x3 purified water, x1 diluted stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Pit Fighter

x1 metal armor (1 level of Decay), x1 lead pipe (2 levels of Decay), x1 brass knuckles, x1 spiked knuckles, x1 bandolier, x1 ball bearings, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

Scouring old world books, crafting theories, using knowledge to help rebuild civilization is your life’s work. You’ve successfully predicted outcomes from natural events and creatures to better help your community to understand the world outside. But you’ve learned what you needed, and now to properly fuel your curiosity; it’s time for field research!

Skills: +2 to Energy Weapons, Breach, and Science.

Trait: Field Research

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Scientist

x1 cloth armor, x1 laser pistol, x10 energy cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x3 cram, x2 purified water, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x1 stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Scientist

x1 cloth armor, x1 laser pistol, x10 energy cells, x1 bag (backpack), x2 robot repair kit 2.0, x1 Programmer's Digest magazine, x1 data scrubber, and x50 caps.

What they don’t tell you about being a book organizer is the faster you do it, the more time you get to read. You’ve spent countless hours organizing a trove of information that you wish you could share with the entire world. The accumulation of knowledge from these texts could better the world if raiders would stop to read a chapter. You’re venturing into the wasteland to share your knowledge, or to find more to add to your collection.

Skills: +2 to Crafting, Energy Weapons, and Medicine.

Trait: Wasteland Knowledge

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Scribe

x1 cloth armor, x1 laser pistol, x10 energy cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x3 cram, x2 purified water, x1 diluted RadAway, x1 Rad-X, x1 stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Scribe

x1 cloth armor, x1 laser pistol, x10 energy cells, x1 bag (backpack), x2 robot repair kit 2.0, x1 Programmer's Digest magazine, x1 data scrubber, and x50 caps.

Ever since you were young you looked up to those who protected your home. Now you’ve joined the ranks to protect others. Following orders is your duty to your people and your fellow soldiers. You’ve been sent on scouting missions, you’ve guarded outposts, and you’ve also seen the horrors of warfare. You’ve obeyed orders to the end, even if you didn’t agree with them. Your term is up, and you’re thinking of putting these skills to use in the wasteland.

Skills: +2 to Explosives, Guns, and Medicine.

Trait: Efficient Combatant

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Soldier

x1 leather armor, x1 combat knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 combat rifle (2 levels of Decay), x25 .45 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x2 cram, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Soldier

x1 leather armor, x1 combat knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 combat rifle (2 levels of Decay), x25 .45 bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

Everyone needs something. You’re a gatherer of valuables that you’ve brought to many cities across the wasteland. You’ve signed deals, bartered caps, and made your customers happy. At the end of the day what matters most is your reputation, and all the caps you’ve made. But your stock has run low, it’s time to set out again to make all that money back again.

Skills: +2 to Barter, Speech, and Intimidation.

Trait: Bargaining Chip

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Trader

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x5 canned dog food, x1 iguana on a stick, x2 healing powder, x4 dirty water, x2 purified water, x1 lockpicks, x1 one person tent, x1 sleeping bag, x1 whiskey, x1 fixer, x2 jet, x3 cigarettes, x1 psycho, x1 coffee and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Trader

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 lockpicks, x2 robot repair kit 1.0, x2 overclock hardware, x2 cache clearer, x1 military auto-tank AI upload, x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, x1 ¡La Fantoma! skill magazine and x50 caps.

For all your life you’ve only known the cold steel walls of a deep underground vault. Everyone wears blue-yellow jumpsuits, wears a pip-boy, and fears the outside. Many of the vaults host some sort of experiment or simulation that torments those inside. However, yours either didn’t have one, or it was so subtle you never realized. But all of that changed when you finally stepped foot outside. The world was never what you thought, the people are different, and it’s larger than you could have ever imagined.

Skills: +2 to Medicine, Speech, and Science.

Trait: Talented / Agoraphobia

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Vault Dweller

x1 vault suit, x1 10mm pistol, x20 10mm ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 canteen, x1 weapon repair kit, x1 pip-boy (any), x1 BlamCo Mac & Cheese, x1 Salisbury Steak, Yum Yum Deviled Eggs, x1 coffee, x4 purified water, x1 stimpak.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Vault Dweller

x1 vault suit, x1 laser pistol, x5 energy cells, x1 bag (backpack), x1 pip-boy (any), x2 robot repair kit 2.0, x1 Programmer's Digest magazine, x1 data scrubber, and x50 caps.

All you’ve ever needed was what’s on your back. You’ve traveled far and wide across the wasteland, trading, meeting folks, and moving on. You’ve killed raiders, explored abandoned ruins, and crossed paths with soldiers. You’re as impactful to this world as a tumbleweed in the desert, but all of that is about to change.

Skills: +2 to Guns, Survival, and Unarmed.

Trait: Adventurer’s Instinct

Starting Equipment: Human Wastelander

x1 leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 10mm pistol, x20 10mm ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x2 mutfruit, x2 apples, x1 vegetable soup, x2 purified water, x1 healing powder, and x50 caps.

Ghoul or Super Mutant Wastelander

x1 leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 10mm pistol, x20 10mm ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x2 mutfruit, x2 apples, x1 vegetable soup, x3 dirty water, x1 nuka-cola, x1 diluted stimpak, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Wastelander

x1 leather armor, x1 sharpened pole, x1 10mm pistol, x20 10mm ammo, x1 bag (backpack), x1 bandolier, x1 binoculars, x1 grappling hook, x1 rope, robot repair kit 1.0, and x50 caps.

entity.name: Arsonist
entity.description:
No matter what you do, you can’t seem to fight the urge to set things ablaze or blow them up in spectacular fashion. You’ve been chased out of more towns and communities than you can count, always leaving a burning wreckage behind you. Now you wander the wastes, seeking somewhere to call home, at least until you burn it to the ground.

Skills: +2 to Explosives, Crafting, and Science.

Trait: Loose Cannon

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Arsonist

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 flare gun, x15 flares, x3 molotov cocktails, x1 bag (backpack), x2 cram, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 purified water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Arsonist

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (2 levels of Decay), x1 flare gun, x15 flares, x3 molotov cocktails, x1 bag (backpack), x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

entity.name: Junkie
entity.description:
You’ve been reliant on chems for much of your life, wandering from place to place seeking a way to score your next high. You’ve done some things you’re not proud of in order to get high, experimenting with wild and strange new chems. You now wander the wastes, perhaps seeking the next great high, or maybe seeking to rid yourself of this addiction once and for all.

Skills: +2 to Crafting, Medicine, and Survival.

Trait: Enhancement Reliant

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Junkie

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (3 levels of Decay), x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm rounds, x3 jet, x2 psycho, x1 med-x, x1 bag (backpack), x2 cram, x1 sleeping bag, x1 one person tent, x1 diluted stimpak, x1 dirty water, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Junkie

x1 cloth armor, x1 knife (3 levels of Decay), x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm rounds, x3 overclock hardware, x2 military auto-tank AI upload, x1 incoming projectile predictor, x1 bag (backpack), x1 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 robot repair kit 2.0, and x50 caps.

entity.name: Escaped Slave
entity.description:
You were captured by a gang of slavers and forced to work under cruel and violent overlords. That is, until you got your lucky break. Maybe you cleverly planned your escape with others, maybe you ran during a slave revolt, or maybe the gang of slavers were wiped out by a third party. Either way, you managed to escape and have been wandering the wasteland since, trying to get by and avoid any slavers who might seek you out.

Skills: +2 to Explosives, Sneak, and Survival.

Trait: Jinxed

Starting Equipment: Human, Ghoul, or Super Mutant Escaped Slave

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x5 canned dog food, x1 iguana on a stick, x2 healing powder, x4 dirty water, x2 purified water, x1 lockpick, x1 one person tent, x1 sleeping bag, x1 deactivated slave collar, and x50 caps.

Gen-2 Synth or Robot Escaped Slave

x1 cloth armor, x1 shiv, x1 pipe pistol (2 levels of Decay), x25 9mm bullets, x1 bag (backpack), x1 lockpick, x2 robot repair kit 1.0, x1 flashlight, x1 energy cell, and x50 caps.
