Your metabolic rate is increased. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your Radiation DC is increased by 3.

Requirement: Human

Wild Wasteland: Your Healing Rate is increased by a number equal to your level, however whenever you gain Rads, you gain twice as many.

Base trait: Your metabolic rate is increased. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your Radiation DC is increased by 3.

Requirement: Robot

You’re made from more accessible and malleable material. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your AC is decreased by 1.

Requirement: Robot

Wild Wasteland: Your Healing Rate is increased by a number equal to your level, however your AC is decreased by 1 and your DT is decreased by 2. This affects any worn armor.

Base trait: You’re made from more accessible and malleable material. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your AC is decreased by 1.

Requirement: Gen-2 Synth

Your fragile wiring is more protected, at the cost of input lag. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your Combat Sequence rolls are decreased by 2.

Requirement: Gen-2 Synth

Wild Wasteland: Your Healing Rate is increased by a number equal to your level, however your Combat Sequence rolls have disadvantage and are decreased by 4.

Base trait: Your fragile wiring is more protected, at the cost of input lag. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your Combat Sequence rolls are decreased by 2.

Requirement: Ghoul

(Incompatible with the Glowing One variant)

Through some mutation, you haven’t fully ghoulified. You can heal the full amount of HP from Stimpaks and you can use Healing Powder. However, you are no longer immune to Radiation and its effects. You have advantage on Radiation checks and are resistant to Radiation damage.

Requirement: Ghoul

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however whenever you gain Rads, you gain twice as many.

Base trait: (Incompatible with the Glowing One variant)

Through some mutation, you haven’t fully ghoulified. You can heal the full amount of HP from Stimpaks and you can use Healing Powder. However, you are no longer immune to Radiation and its effects. You have advantage on Radiation checks and are resistant to Radiation damage.

Requirement: Super Mutant

Your metabolic rate is increased. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your maximum SP is reduced by a number equal to your level.

Requirement: Super Mutant

Wild Wasteland: Your Healing Rate is increased by a number equal to your level, however your maximum SP is reduced by a number equal to your level and whenever you regain SP from a rest, you regain half as much.

Base trait: Your metabolic rate is increased. Your Healing Rate is increased by 2, however your maximum SP is reduced by a number equal to your level.

You may not hit as often, but they will feel it when you do! When you damage a creature with a Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the damage is increased by 3. However, any Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack costs 1 additional AP.

entity.name: Bruiser (Wild Wasteland)
entity.description:
Wild Wasteland: When you damage a creature with a Melee Weapon or Unarmed Weapon attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the damage is increased by an additional damage dice. However, any Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack costs 2 additional AP.

Base trait: You may not hit as often, but they will feel it when you do! When you damage a creature with a Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the damage is increased by 3. However, any Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack costs 1 additional AP.

fields.description: Any damage you deal with a weapon is increased by 1, however when you critically miss on an attack roll, the weapon gains 2 levels of Decay instead of 1.

Wild Wasteland: Any damage you deal with a weapon is increased by 2, however when you attack with a weapon, it gains the Breakable condition.

Base trait: Any damage you deal with a weapon is increased by 1, however when you critically miss on an attack roll, the weapon gains 2 levels of Decay instead of 1.

Incompatible with the Enhancement Resistant trait.

You’re accustomed to the rush of chemical enhancements or the electrodes of programs. If you are addicted, you lose the addiction once you take a Long Rest. However, you have disadvantage on any Endurance ability check to resist becoming addicted.

Wild Wasteland: If you are addicted, you lose the addiction after you take a Short Rest. However, you always become addicted after using a Chem or Robot Overclock Program.

Base trait: Incompatible with the Enhancement Resistant trait.

You’re accustomed to the rush of chemical enhancements or the electrodes of programs. If you are addicted, you lose the addiction once you take a Long Rest. However, you have disadvantage on any Endurance ability check to resist becoming addicted.

Incompatible with the Agoraphobia trait.

You have a fear of enclosed spaces. The effects from your Party Nerve are doubled while you are outside. However, you do not gain the benefits of your Party Nerve while indoors or underground.

fields.name: Claustrophobia (Wild Wasteland)
fields.description:
Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, you gain advantage on all ability and skill checks while outside, but disadvantage when indoors or underground.

Base trait: Incompatible with the Agoraphobia trait.

You have a fear of enclosed spaces. The effects from your Party Nerve are doubled while you are outside. However, you do not gain the benefits of your Party Nerve while indoors or underground.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Incompatible with the Night Person trait.

You can roll a d4 and add the number to any Ability or Skill check you make from the hours of 6 AM to 12 PM. However, you gain an additional level of Exhaustion if you do not rest for 24 hours.

fields.name: Early Bird (Wild Wasteland)
fields.description:
Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the trait’s effects, you gain +2 to all Skills in the morning (6 AM to 12 PM), but -1 during the night (6 PM to 6 AM).

Base trait: Incompatible with the Night Person trait.

You can roll a d4 and add the number to any Ability or Skill check you make from the hours of 6 AM to 12 PM. However, you gain an additional level of Exhaustion if you do not rest for 24 hours.

Incompatible with the Enhancement Reliant trait.

Your body works hard to be resistant to addiction. You have advantage on any Endurance ability checks to resist becoming addicted, however when you use a Chem or Robot Overclock Program, the benefits last for half as long as the duration.

Wild Wasteland: You become immune to addiction, however whenever you use a Chem or Robot Overclock Program, the benefit lasts for only one round regardless of duration.

Base trait: Incompatible with the Enhancement Reliant trait.

Your body works hard to be resistant to addiction. You have advantage on any Endurance ability checks to resist becoming addicted, however when you use a Chem or Robot Overclock Program, the benefits last for half as long as the duration.

You don’t have time to aim because you’re already firing! Whenever you spend AP to make an attack with a Ranged Weapon or Explosive, you can choose to have disadvantage on the attack roll. If you do, the attack costs 1 less AP, to a minimum of 3 AP.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, you have advantage whenever you roll Combat Sequence, however you cannot make Targeted Attacks with Ranged Weapons.

Base trait: You don’t have time to aim because you’re already firing! Whenever you spend AP to make an attack with a Ranged Weapon or Explosive, you can choose to have disadvantage on the attack roll. If you do, the attack costs 1 less AP, to a minimum of 3 AP.
You’ve survived in the heart of the savage wasteland. Whenever you deal damage with a Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack, you deal 2 extra damage. However, you do not gain the benefits from Party Nerve.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, whenever you spend at least 6 AP to move, you immediately gain 2 AP. However, you have disadvantage on all Barter and Speech checks, and you are considered to have 4 Charisma for perk requirements, regardless of your Charisma ability score unless your score is 3 or less.

Base trait: You’ve survived in the heart of the savage wasteland. Whenever you deal damage with a Melee or Unarmed Weapon attack, you deal 2 extra damage. However, you do not gain the benefits from Party Nerve.
Whenever you critically hit with a weapon, either the critical damage multiplier increases by 1 or the damage dice increases by 1. However, when you make an attack roll, the result is reduced by 1.

Wild Wasteland: Whenever you critically hit with a weapon, either the critical damage multiplier increases by 2 or the damage dice increases by 2. However, when you make an attack roll, the result is reduced by 2.

Base trait: Whenever you critically hit with a weapon, either the critical damage multiplier increases by 1 or the damage dice increases by 1. However, when you make an attack roll, the result is reduced by 1.

You have more innate abilities than most, so you have not spent as much time honing your skills. Your Carry Load increases by 10, your Combat Sequence bonus increases by 1, you can use Discount an additional time before resting, your Party Nerve increases by 1, and you have an additional Karma Cap. However, all of your Skill modifiers are decreased by 4.

Wild Wasteland: Your Carry Load increases by 20, your Combat Sequence bonus increases by 2, you can use Discount 2 additional times per rest, your Party Nerve increases by 2, and you have 2 additional Karma Caps. However, all of your Skill modifiers are decreased by 8.

Base trait: You have more innate abilities than most, so you have not spent as much time honing your skills. Your Carry Load increases by 10, your Combat Sequence bonus increases by 1, you can use Discount an additional time before resting, your Party Nerve increases by 1, and you have an additional Karma Cap. However, all of your Skill modifiers are decreased by 4.
While your SP is 0, at the start of your turn you can choose to gain 2 SP. However, if you do so, your AC and DT are decreased by 2 (minimum of 8 AC and 0 DT) until the start of your next turn.

Wild Wasteland: While your SP is 0, at the start of your turn you can choose to have 15 AP, regardless of your Agility ability score. However, if you do, your AC is 8 and your DT is 0 until the start of your next turn.

Base trait: While your SP is 0, at the start of your turn you can choose to gain 2 SP. However, if you do so, your AC and DT are decreased by 2 (minimum of 8 AC and 0 DT) until the start of your next turn.

You’re good natured at heart, more prone to solving problems with your mind than violence. Regardless of your Charisma ability score, you are considered to have +2 in Charisma for any perk requirement. However, regardless of your Agility and Strength ability scores, you are considered to have -2 in Agility and Strength for any perk requirement.

Wild Wasteland: You are considered to have a 10 in Charisma for perk requirements, however you are considered to have a 4 in Agility and Strength for any perk requirement. If you have a 3 or lower in Agility and Strength, this does not apply to the relevant ability.

Base trait: You’re good natured at heart, more prone to solving problems with your mind than violence. Regardless of your Charisma ability score, you are considered to have +2 in Charisma for any perk requirement. However, regardless of your Agility and Strength ability scores, you are considered to have -2 in Agility and Strength for any perk requirement.
You gain a bonus to your HP equal to your level, however your SP is reduced by a number equal to your level.

Wild Wasteland: You gain a bonus to your HP equal to double your level, however your SP is reduced by a number equal to double your level.

Base trait: You gain a bonus to your HP equal to your level, however your SP is reduced by a number equal to your level.
Your Carry Load increases by 25, however if you are not carrying at least 50 Load of equipment, you have disadvantage on all skill checks.

effects.text: Hoarder: Your Carry Load increases by 25, however if you are not carrying at least 50 Load of equipment, you have disadvantage on all skill checks.

fields.description:
Wild Wasteland: In addition to this trait’s effects, you are immune to the Encumbered condition, however if you are carrying less than your maximum Carry Load, you gain a level of Exhaustion that cannot be removed until you increase your load.

Base trait: Your Carry Load increases by 25, however if you are not carrying at least 50 Load of equipment, you have disadvantage on all skill checks.

effects.text: Encumbered

Hoarder (Wild Wasteland): In addition to this trait’s effects, you are immune to the Encumbered condition, however if you are carrying less than your maximum Carry Load, you gain a level of Exhaustion that cannot be removed until you increase your load.

fields.description: While your SP is 0, when you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage roll, you can reroll the die and must take the new roll. However, whenever you make an attack roll while your SP is 0, the result is decreased by 2.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to this trait's effects, when your SP is 0, the damage you deal from any damage roll is increased by 5. However, you have disadvantage on all your attack rolls while your SP is 0.

Base trait: While your SP is 0, when you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage roll, you can reroll the die and must take the new roll. However, whenever you make an attack roll while your SP is 0, the result is decreased by 2.

The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat, the bad thing is - so do you! Whenever any creature makes an attack roll, the chance to critically miss is increased by 1 (so a natural 1 or 2 counts as a critical miss). For every player with this trait, the critical miss chance further increases.

Wild Wasteland: Whenever any creature makes an attack roll, the chance to critically miss is increased by 2 (so a natural 1, 2, or 3 is a critical miss).

Base trait: The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat, the bad thing is - so do you! Whenever any creature makes an attack roll, the chance to critically miss is increased by 1 (so a natural 1 or 2 counts as a critical miss). For every player with this trait, the critical miss chance further increases.
Whenever you spend AP to throw an explosive, you spend 1 less AP, to a minimum of 3 AP. However, you can only throw them up to half their listed range.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to this trait’s effects, if an explosive you threw damages a player character, all other non-player characters in the radius take double damage.

Base trait: Whenever you spend AP to throw an explosive, you spend 1 less AP, to a minimum of 3 AP. However, you can only throw them up to half their listed range.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Incompatible with the Early Bird trait.

You can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to any Ability or Skill check you make from the hours of 6 PM to 6 AM. However, you gain an additional level of Exhaustion if you do not rest for 24 hours.

fields.name: Night Person (Wild Wasteland)
fields.description:
Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the trait’s effects, you have -1 to all skills in the morning (6 AM to 12 PM), but a +2 during the night (6 PM to 6 AM).

Base trait: Incompatible with the Early Bird trait.

You can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to any Ability or Skill check you make from the hours of 6 PM to 6 AM. However, you gain an additional level of Exhaustion if you do not rest for 24 hours.
Whenever you make an attack roll with a one-handed weapon, add 2 to the result. However, whenever you make an attack roll with a two-handed weapon, reduce the result by 2.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to this trait’s effects, whenever you deal damage with a one-handed weapon, add 2 to the result. However, when you deal damage with a two-handed weapon, reduce the result by 2.

Base trait: Whenever you make an attack roll with a one-handed weapon, add 2 to the result. However, whenever you make an attack roll with a two-handed weapon, reduce the result by 2.

When you critically hit with an attack roll, roll a d20. If you roll a 20 on this d20, then you automatically hit and roll x4 the critical hit damage. If you do not roll a 20, your attack still hits but does not deal any extra critical damage.

Wild Wasteland: When you critically hit with an attack roll, roll a d20. If you roll a 20 on this d20, then you roll a third d20. If you roll a 20 on the third d20, then you automatically hit and deal x8 the critical hit damage. If you do not roll a 20 on the second or third d20, your attack hits but does not deal extra critical damage.

Base trait: When you critically hit with an attack roll, roll a d20. If you roll a 20 on this d20, then you automatically hit and roll x4 the critical hit damage. If you do not roll a 20, your attack still hits but does not deal any extra critical damage.

entity.requires_text: An Ability score less than or equal to 3

entity.name: Skilled (Wild Wasteland)
entity.requirement: An Ability score less than or equal to 3
entity.description:
Requirement: An Ability score less than or equal to 3

Wild Wasteland: Requires an Ability score equal to 1. Increase one Skill modifier by 5.

Base trait: Increase one Skill modifier by 2.
entity.requires_text: An Ability score less than or equal to 3

fields.description: You gain a bonus to your SP equal to your level, however your HP is reduced by a number equal to your level.

Wild Wasteland: You gain a bonus to your SP equal to double your level, however your HP is reduced by a number equal to double your level.

Base trait: You gain a bonus to your SP equal to your level, however your HP is reduced by a number equal to your level.
Whenever you make a Targeted Attack with a Ranged Weapon, the additional AP cost is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1 AP). However, your Combat Sequence modifier is reduced by 2.

Wild Wasteland: Whenever you make a Targeted Attack roll with a Ranged Weapon, the additional AP cost is reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1 AP). However, your Combat Sequence modifier is reduced by 5.

Base trait: Whenever you make a Targeted Attack with a Ranged Weapon, the additional AP cost is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1 AP). However, your Combat Sequence modifier is reduced by 2.

Whenever you and your party rests or travels, you play music, sing a song, recount a story, or give an inspiring speech. You and every party member gain Temporary SP equal to your Charisma ability score. However, while traveling, your party’s Group Sneak is reduced by 2 as long as you’re in the party.

Wild Wasteland: You and your party members gain Temporary SP equal to double your Charisma ability modifier, but your party’s Group Sneak is reduced by 5 as long as you’re in the party.

Base trait: Whenever you and your party rests or travels, you play music, sing a song, recount a story, or give an inspiring speech. You and every party member gain Temporary SP equal to your Charisma ability score. However, while traveling, your party’s Group Sneak is reduced by 2 as long as you’re in the party.
Whenever you sell an item, you can use your Discount ability to gain bonus caps equal to your double your Barter skill modifier. However, you sell all items for 10% less than their listed value.

Wild Wasteland: Your Discount ability grants you bonus caps equal to triple your Barter skill modifier, however you sell all items at 20% less than their listed value.

Base trait: Whenever you sell an item, you can use your Discount ability to gain bonus caps equal to your double your Barter skill modifier. However, you sell all items for 10% less than their listed value.

“Primum non nocere”, you’ve taken the hippocratic oath and intend to heal others in the wasteland instead of hurting them. Whenever you use a First Aid Kit, Stimpak, Doctor’s Bag, or ability to heal another creature’s HP, you restore an additional 1 HP. Whenever you attack another creature and deal damage, the damage is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

fields.name: Do No Harm (Wild Wasteland)
fields.description:
Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, whenever you spend 6 AP to roll a Medicine skill check on a Dying creature to return them to 1 HP, the check automatically succeeds. However, if you ever kill another creature by damaging them, you lose all abilities from this trait.

Base trait: “Primum non nocere”, you’ve taken the hippocratic oath and intend to heal others in the wasteland instead of hurting them. Whenever you use a First Aid Kit, Stimpak, Doctor’s Bag, or ability to heal another creature’s HP, you restore an additional 1 HP. Whenever you attack another creature and deal damage, the damage is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Whenever you make an attack roll and you roll a 1, as long as you are not attacking at disadvantage, you can reroll and must take the new result. However, you no longer flip over your Karma Cap when you critically miss on an attack roll.

Wild Wasteland: As long as you are not attacking at disadvantage, if you roll a 1, you do not critically fail and can add your modifier to the attack. Your weapon still takes a level of Decay. However, when you make an attack roll and the result is a critical hit, you deal no extra critical damage.

Base trait: Whenever you make an attack roll and you roll a 1, as long as you are not attacking at disadvantage, you can reroll and must take the new result. However, you no longer flip over your Karma Cap when you critically miss on an attack roll.
If you roll an 18 or higher on a Death Save, you return to 1 HP. However, you do not add your Luck or Endurance ability modifiers to your Death Saves.

Wild Wasteland: If you roll a 15+ on a Death Save, you return to 1 HP, however you do not add your Luck ability modifier, Endurance ability modifier, or Party Nerve to your Death Saves.

Base trait: If you roll an 18 or higher on a Death Save, you return to 1 HP. However, you do not add your Luck or Endurance ability modifiers to your Death Saves.

Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, every player character can optionally choose to gain advantage on the first attack roll they make on their first turn. However, if they critically hit on their first attack, they do not deal any extra critical damage.

Wild Wasteland: Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, every player character can choose to gain advantage on their first 2 attacks they make. However, if they critically hit on their 1st or 2nd attack, they do not deal extra critical damage.

Base trait: Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, every player character can optionally choose to gain advantage on the first attack roll they make on their first turn. However, if they critically hit on their first attack, they do not deal any extra critical damage.

Whenever you deal damage to a creature whose type you’ve fought before, the damage is increased by 2. However, if you haven’t fought a creature of that type before, the damage is reduced by 2. A creature type is only considered to have been fought after an encounter ends.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to this trait’s effects, when you gain bonus XP after an encounter with a creature type you’ve never fought before, you gain an additional 20% bonus XP. However, if you have fought with that creature type before, you gain 10% less bonus XP.

Base trait: Whenever you deal damage to a creature whose type you’ve fought before, the damage is increased by 2. However, if you haven’t fought a creature of that type before, the damage is reduced by 2. A creature type is only considered to have been fought after an encounter ends.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

You can make an Endurance check with a DC equal to 12 - END ability modifier to resist taking a level of Hunger or Exhaustion, however you fall Unconscious if you reach 8 levels of Fatigue instead of 10.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, whenever your HP or SP increase from leveling up, you gain 1 extra point in each. However, the negative effects from levels of Hunger and Exhaustion are doubled.

Base trait: You can make an Endurance check with a DC equal to 12 - END ability modifier to resist taking a level of Hunger or Exhaustion, however you fall Unconscious if you reach 8 levels of Fatigue instead of 10.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Whenever your SP increases from leveling up, you gain a 1 extra SP, however you gain an additional level of Exhaustion when you travel beyond your Travel Limits or do not sleep.

Requirement: Human, Ghoul or Super Mutant

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, whenever your SP increases from leveling up, you gain another 1 SP (total of 2). However, whenever you regain SP from a Short Rest, you regain 1/4th of your maximum SP instead of half.

Base trait: Whenever your SP increases from leveling up, you gain a 1 extra SP, however you gain an additional level of Exhaustion when you travel beyond your Travel Limits or do not sleep.

Whenever the party travels at a fast pace, you can choose to travel an additional 2 miles per hour. However, if you do, at the end of each hour, you and every other player character must succeed a DC 12 Endurance ability check or gain a level of Exhaustion. Whenever a player succeeds this check, the DC increases for them by +2 for the next time they make the check. This resets on a Long Rest.

Wild Wasteland: You can choose to travel an additional 5 miles per hour when traveling at a fast pace, however at the end of each hour every player character gains a level of Exhaustion.

Base trait: Whenever the party travels at a fast pace, you can choose to travel an additional 2 miles per hour. However, if you do, at the end of each hour, you and every other player character must succeed a DC 12 Endurance ability check or gain a level of Exhaustion. Whenever a player succeeds this check, the DC increases for them by +2 for the next time they make the check. This resets on a Long Rest.
Whenever you flip a Karma Cap to reroll a skill check, you gain advantage on the roll. However, your Karma Caps no longer flip back over whenever you roll a 1 on a d20.

Wild Wasteland: Whenever you flip a Karma Cap to reroll an ability check, a skill check, or an attack roll, you make the roll at advantage. However, you start each game session with one of your Karma Caps flipped.

Base trait: Whenever you flip a Karma Cap to reroll a skill check, you gain advantage on the roll. However, your Karma Caps no longer flip back over whenever you roll a 1 on a d20.
You ignore the first 2 levels of Decay for armor or weapons. However, your equipment becomes non-functional when they reach 8 levels of Decay instead of 10.

Wild Wasteland: You ignore the first 4 levels of Decay for armor or weapons. However, your equipment becomes non-functional when they reach 6 levels of Decay instead of 10.

Base trait: You ignore the first 2 levels of Decay for armor or weapons. However, your equipment becomes non-functional when they reach 8 levels of Decay instead of 10.
You’ve spent more time honing your skills than learning new things. Instead of gaining a perk at 1st level, you can increase 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice by 3.

effects.text: Recluse: You’ve spent more time honing your skills than learning new things. Instead of gaining a perk at 1st level, you can increase 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice by 3.

fields.description:
Wild Wasteland: Instead of gaining a perk at 1st and 2nd level, all your Skill modifiers increase by 3.

Base trait: You’ve spent more time honing your skills than learning new things. Instead of gaining a perk at 1st level, you can increase 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice by 3.

Due to your experience in the streets, you have advantage on any Sneak or Breach skill checks you make in a settlement or otherwise populated area. However, due to your poor reputation, you have disadvantage on Speech or Barter skill checks you make in a settlement or otherwise populated area.

Wild Wasteland: In addition to the traits effects, you can use your Discount ability 3 times before resting. However, you have a Level 2 Bounty on your head. Discuss with your Overseer about the details on this bounty.

Base trait: Due to your experience in the streets, you have advantage on any Sneak or Breach skill checks you make in a settlement or otherwise populated area. However, due to your poor reputation, you have disadvantage on Speech or Barter skill checks you make in a settlement or otherwise populated area.
Whenever you use your Discount ability, the percentage discount is tripled. However, all items cost 10% more for you.

Wild Wasteland: The percentage discount is sextupled (x6), however all items cost 25% more for you.

Base trait: Whenever you use your Discount ability, the percentage discount is tripled. However, all items cost 10% more for you.
You gain an extra perk at 1st level, however 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice are decreased by 3.

effects.text: Talented: You gain an extra perk at 1st level, however 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice are decreased by 3.

fields.description:
Wild Wasteland: You gain 2 extra perks at 1st level, but all Skill modifiers are decreased by 3.

Base trait: You gain an extra perk at 1st level, however 5 different Skill modifiers of your choice are decreased by 3.

You often hear the whispers of the great beyond, receiving paranormal visions of prophecy. When you finish a Long Rest, you may roll a d20 and record the result. This is your Sight roll, which you can use to replace any attack roll, skill check, or ability check made by you or another creature that you can see. Once you use this Sight roll, you cannot use it again until you take a Long Rest.

However, you start each game session with one of your Karma Caps flipped.

Wild Wasteland: You may make 2 Sight rolls after taking a Long Rest, but your Karma Caps no longer flip if you ever critically fail.

Base trait: You often hear the whispers of the great beyond, receiving paranormal visions of prophecy. When you finish a Long Rest, you may roll a d20 and record the result. This is your Sight roll, which you can use to replace any attack roll, skill check, or ability check made by you or another creature that you can see. Once you use this Sight roll, you cannot use it again until you take a Long Rest.

However, you start each game session with one of your Karma Caps flipped.
Whenever Combat Sequence is rolled, your turn is automatically put before a non-player creature placed before you, regardless of their roll. However, your Combat Sequence roll is reduced by 1.

Wild Wasteland: Your turn placement is automatically put before 2 non-player creatures placed before you, regardless of their rolls. However, you have disadvantage on Combat Sequence rolls and your roll is reduced by 2.

Base trait: Whenever Combat Sequence is rolled, your turn is automatically put before a non-player creature placed before you, regardless of their roll. However, your Combat Sequence roll is reduced by 1.

Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, you can choose to know either the HP, SP, AP, AC, or DT total of any other hostile creatures. However, each creature you choose with this ability can reroll their Combat Sequence for a potentially higher placement.
